name: Cross-level Adaptive Encoding
definition: A technique to optimize encoding by reusing NCP results from lower Levels of Detail (LOD) to avoid exhaustive search for higher LODs. It identifies 'simple' micro-blocks (NCP = degree+2) and 'complex' micro-blocks (NCP > degree+2) at each LOD.
summary: Cross-level Adaptive Encoding is a hierarchical optimization technique that reduces volume rendering encoding time by using lower LOD results to skip exhaustive searches for higher LODs.
